nonblocking_limitations.description: Single-rank launch, contemporary runtime, selective adapter, pinned non-weight config and pin_memory=False are explicit adaptations; exact author or numerical equivalence is not established.
Resource evidence measures seed 0 epoch 0 and full VALID. Later epochs/seeds and selected full-state serialization are not measured; no concrete source blocker warrants another resource-only stage.
RSS/CUDA supervision is sampled and final finite publication/stdio tails are disclosed; no instantaneous OS limit or process-escape sandbox is claimed.
The root runner follows existing seed order 0,1,2 and stops after a failed fit. Individual commands are prepared; no autonomous three-fit client is supplied.
External root release and existing exact dependency/runtime inventory binding remain launch prerequisites; this review performs no remote environment validation.
Historical Collab TEST consumption is retained. No TEST evaluation or unseen-heldout claim is released.
